correctness.rationale: All primes and depths are handled by Lucas digit inequalities, a unique trailing-(p-1) suffix, exact cancellation of upper digit factors, and a finite-field reflection giving p-1 versus (p-1)/2 local counts. Higher positions contribute Q_p^j, proving the all-depth spectrum. Character orthogonality yields exact chi(-1)/p, and the signed single-digit sum H_p with |H_p|<Q_p proves the four-sign law. Standalone checker.py passed 57,254 finite assertions; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The object is the natural quotient of successive nonzero Pascal coefficients. Exact ratio fibers across all primes and every complete p-ary row cutoff identify a universal doubled -1 class; single-entry residue frequencies and support counts do not predict it. The exact persistent quadratic-character nearest-neighbor dependence despite individually balanced signs supplies a motivated structural consequence beyond a finite numerical census.
